newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midwest direct hog prices seen steady-dealers.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midwest direct hog prices seen steady-dealers.

text.p: U.S. Midwest direct cash hog prices Friday were seen steady, but markets could be disrupted by persistent wintry weather, livestock dealers said.
Wind-driven snow Thursday in southeast South Dakota, southern Minnesota and parts of Iowa sharply restricted hog movement, resulting in curtailed slaughter operations.
USDA estimated the Iowa/southern Minnesota hog run Thursday at 95,000 head, well below 114,000 a week ago and 109,000 a year ago.
Also, USDA estimated hog slaughter Thursday at 325,000 head, below 365,000 a week ago and 373,000 a year ago.
